summary: Hub Cyber Security Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a share purchase agreement to sell 100% of QPoint Group to Martens Computer Consultants and Malam Training. Consideration is 2x fiscal 2025 gross profit, approximately NIS 26.5 million ($8.7 million), payable at closing on a cash-free, debt-free basis. Closing conditions include Israel Competition Authority clearance, removal of pledges on QPoint shares, and third-party consents; closing occurs seven working days after clearance. Portions of consideration are held in trust to secure indemnification obligations. Proceeds will repay substantially all debt secured by QPoint shares, strengthening the balance sheet. Watch for regulatory clearance timing and closing certainty.
